title: colony.json
description: @generated by colony-tokens — DO NOT EDIT. The manifest a Project Colony repository ships at its root so the launcher can list and install it.

name.description: Display name in the launcher. May differ from the repository name — this is the only field the user actually reads.

category.description: Which section of the launcher files this program. Matched case-insensitively. Colony warns and ignores an unrecognized value, which files the program nowhere. Canonical values: development, graphics, network, office, multimedia, system, utility, security, game, other.

platforms.description: Leave empty to let Colony auto-detect from release asset names following the convention (linux: <repo>-linux, windows: <repo>-windows.exe, macos-x86: <repo>-macos-x86, macos: <repo>-macos). "macos" is Apple Silicon, "macos-x86" is Intel.

releaseFiles.description: Explicit per-platform asset resolution. Only needed when the assets do not follow the naming convention, or when installing from an archive. If present, it must cover every declared platform.

linux.description: Which asset to fetch for this platform, and how to treat it once downloaded.

tag.description: A git tag, or the literal "latest" to always track the newest release.

file.description: Exact asset filename. Mutually exclusive with filePattern.

filePattern.description: Case-insensitive pattern matched against the release's asset names, for assets whose name carries the version. Must match exactly one asset.

binary.description: Binary to extract from inside the downloaded archive (.zip / .tar.gz). Omit when the downloaded file is itself the binary.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the asset, 64 lowercase hex characters.

icon.description: Repo-relative path to a square PNG. When absent, Colony probes icon.png at the repo root, then falls back to a category hexagon tinted by the program's name.

signed.description: Require a valid detached ed25519 signature for every asset. When true, a missing or invalid <asset>.sig aborts the install instead of falling back to the unsigned path.
